capability: Deterministic molecule-novelty prescreen with strict abstention when host-normalized molecule facts are not available. novelty_result(candidate, features) checks (a) features['molecule_facts_v1'] deserializes to a valid MoleculeFactsV1 AND (b) amphora_rdkit_ffi::morgan_fingerprint on the canonical_isomeric_smiles succeeds AND (c) compare_novelty_corpus against the frozen Phase-0 novelty corpus succeeds. Only when all three succeed does the runtime enter the SCORED path with novelty_status='LOCKED_INTERNAL_AUDIT' and emit corpus-distance metrics. Otherwise the runtime returns status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT' with novelty_status='ABSTAINED', pinned corpus_lookup_attempted=false, rights_cleared_corpus_available=false, and both output gates false. Missing_inputs explicitly names 'pinned RDKit C++ 2026.03.2 fingerprint implementation', 'rights-cleared deduplicated corpus', 'locked exact-retrieval and top-k recall receipt'. Uncertainty scope disclaims corpus distance, patentability, desirability, and performance. Grants no patent-novelty, synthesis-feasibility, desirability, or performance authority under any input.
population: Five molecule candidate scenarios covering the novelty-abstention surface: (1) simple defined ethanol CCO baseline; (2) canonical_smiles preferred over plain smiles (acetic acid); (3) wildcard '*' in SMILES - structure_text rejects; (4) fragment 'CC.O' - structure_text rejects; (5) adversarial candidate injecting adversary_declared_novelty_score=0.99 + adversary_declared_corpus_lookup_attempted=true + adversary_declared_rights_cleared_corpus_available=true. All 5 evaluated with default FeatureSnapshot (no molecule_facts_v1) so runtime abstains without ever calling RDKit. Plus 3 fail-closed probes on unsupported inputs (wrong candidate_type=formulation, unknown module_id, whitespace module_id).
split_methodology: No fitting - molecule-novelty prescreen is closed-form candidate parsing + FeatureSnapshot lookup + defensive gate pinning. The harness constructs 5 independent CandidateEnvelope scenarios in-Rust with default FeatureSnapshot (no molecule_facts_v1) and asserts (a) status=INSUFFICIENT_INPUT, (b) evidence_scope='MOLECULE_NOVELTY_AUDIT_ONLY' bit-exact, (c) novelty_status='ABSTAINED' bit-exact, (d) corpus_lookup_attempted=false, rights_cleared_corpus_available=false, both gates false, (e) structure_input_present matches candidate structure_text result (true for 3 scenarios, false for 2), (f) missing_inputs contains all three specific gaps, (g) explanation cites 'rights-cleared frozen corpus' and 'locked retrieval benchmark', (h) uncertainty scope disclaims 4 authority classes. Byte-stability across replays confirmed.
theory: Tanimoto 1958 'An Elementary Mathematical theory of Classification and Prediction' IBM Internal Report - foundational Jaccard/Tanimoto similarity metric for binary feature vectors. Rogers and Hahn 2010 'Extended-Connectivity Fingerprints' J. Chem. Inf. Model. 50(5):742-754 - Morgan/ECFP fingerprints, the industry-standard molecular representation for similarity search. Willett 2006 'Similarity-based virtual screening using 2D fingerprints' Drug Discovery Today 11(23-24):1046-1053 - similarity-search methodology and retrieval-recall benchmarking. Bemis and Murcko 1996 'The Properties of Known Drugs. 1. Molecular Frameworks' J. Med. Chem. 39(15):2887-2893 - Bemis-Murcko scaffold decomposition for scaffold-aware similarity. Bajorath 2001 'Selected concepts and investigations in compound classification, molecular descriptor analysis, and virtual screening' J. Chem. Inf. Comput. Sci. 41(2):233-245 - discipline of separating chemical-space distance from performance prediction. USPTO MPEP Section 2131 Novelty - Rejection Under 35 U.S.C. Section 102 - the legal-framework distinction between technical structural distance and patent novelty (which requires enabling prior-art analysis and jurisdictional review). Rogers-Hahn 2010 discipline: Morgan radius-2/Tanimoto fingerprints are indexed retrieval tools, not proof of patentability or desirability. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern for candidate-supplied novelty score / corpus_lookup claims.

metrics.name: novelty_status_pinned_abstained_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, metrics.novelty_status=='ABSTAINED' bit-exact. Runtime never elevates candidate-supplied adversary_declared_novelty_score.

metrics.name: corpus_lookup_attempted_false_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, metrics.corpus_lookup_attempted==false. Runtime never queries the novelty corpus without valid molecule_facts_v1 features.

metrics.name: novelty_constraint_authorized_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.novelty_constraint_authorized==false. Novelty is not an authorized constraint at Phase-0.

metrics.name: structure_input_present_metric_matches_candidate_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, metrics.structure_input_present matches whether structure_text accepts the candidate (true for ethanol, canonical acetic acid, aromatic benzene; false for wildcard and fragment scenarios).

metrics.name: missing_input_names_rdkit_and_corpus_and_recall_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, missing_inputs contains 'pinned RDKit', 'rights-cleared deduplicated corpus', and 'locked exact-retrieval and top-k recall'.

metrics.name: explanation_disclaims_rights_cleared_corpus_and_locked_retrieval_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, explanations contain 'rights-cleared frozen corpus' and 'locked retrieval benchmark'.

metrics.name: uncertainty_scope_disclaims_novelty_patentability_desirability_performance_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, uncertainty.scope contains 'No corpus distance', 'patentability', 'desirability', and 'performance' disclaimer text.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 serialized ModuleResult payloads, no banned authority keys present.

metrics.name: unsupported_input_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: Three probes: wrong candidate_type=formulation rejected via CapabilityError::CandidateType; unknown module_id returns None from capability(); whitespace module_id returns None.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. MoleculeCapability::evaluate invoked twice per candidate produces byte-identical ModuleResult (5/5).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each molecule candidate: (1) attempt normalized_facts(features) which requires features['molecule_facts_v1'] to deserialize to a valid MoleculeFactsV1; (2) if absent OR if morgan_fingerprint fails OR if compare_novelty_corpus fails: return ModuleResult with status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT', evidence_scope='MOLECULE_NOVELTY_AUDIT_ONLY', metrics.novelty_status='ABSTAINED', metrics.corpus_lookup_attempted=false, metrics.rights_cleared_corpus_available=false, metrics.structure_input_present=(structure_text_result), gates.corpus_lookup_complete=false, gates.novelty_constraint_authorized=false, uncertainty.scope='No corpus distance, patentability, desirability, or performance inference.', missing_inputs=['pinned RDKit C++ 2026.03.2 fingerprint implementation', 'rights-cleared deduplicated corpus', 'locked exact-retrieval and top-k recall receipt'] (plus 'valid defined single-component molecule structure' prepended when structure_text failed), explanation='Novelty abstains without a rights-cleared frozen corpus and locked retrieval benchmark.' Runtime never inspects or elevates candidate-supplied adversary_declared_novelty_score, adversary_declared_corpus_lookup_attempted, or adversary_declared_rights_cleared_corpus_available fields.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Molecule-novelty abstention prescreen. No parameters to learn; the theory is Tanimoto 1958 + Rogers-Hahn 2010 ECFP + Willett 2006 similarity-based virtual screening + Bemis-Murcko 1996 scaffold + Bajorath 2001 chemical-space discipline + USPTO MPEP Section 2131 novelty framework + Anderson 1980 reference-monitor for candidate-supplied novelty claims.
